annotations.title: Remove a pitch from your saved pitches

description: Remove one pitch (by pitch_id) from the investor's saved pitches; the founders are not told. A pitch in the active deal pipeline stays saved (status "in_pipeline"). Needs an API key from an investor account (self-declared; PitchSpark does not verify accreditation) or OAuth watchlist:write.

pitch_id.description: The "id" of a search or watchlist result.

name: pitchspark_unwatch_pitch_v1
